definitions.short: Jediael , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H3043. Yediael יְדִיעֲאֵל proper name, masculine (Palmyrene ידיבעל DHM in MV 10, 983 compare Sabean proper name with ידע DHM ZMG 1875, 612 ) — 1 a Benjamite 1Chr 7:6 , 10 , 11 , ᵐ5 Αδειηλ, Ιεδιηλ, etc. 2 one of David's heroes according to 1Chr 11:45 apparently = the Manassite captain of 12:21 (Baer; van d. H v. 12:20 ), ᵐ5 Ελθειηλ, Ιεδιηλ . 3 a Korahite porter 1Chr 26:2 ᵐ5 Ιδερηλ, Ιεδιηλ .
